thread:
Maria R.: Customer (AcmeFin) asks to onboard tempest-13b-v2 on Dedicated (EU). Requirements: p95 latency <220ms, int8 quant preferred, private data residency, deterministic outputs. They uploaded model artifacts to s3://acmefin/models/tempest-13b-v2/ and an eval suite at s3://acmefin/evals/tempest-eval-1k.jsonl

Ajay K.: @Maria R. thanks — do we know the model format + tokenizer? any custom CUDA ops or xformers?

Maria R.: Model is HF pytorch, GPT-style. Tokenizer: SentencePiece. It imports xformers for attention but no bespoke CUDA kernels. Customer emphasized deterministic inference for scoring.

Tess (ML Eng): Quick triage checklist (high level):
- verify HF weights/checksum
- run conversion to runtime-compatible format (onnx/tvm) and op coverage report
- PTQ (int8) benchmark on our perf harness
- latency smoke on A100-80G Dedicated nodes + small CPU baseline
- privacy: ensure Private deployment (VPC) + no external telemetry
- rollout: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with auto-fallback
I'll pick up conversion + PTQ. @Ajay K. can you provision infra?

QuantBot: model_scan(tempest-13b-v2) -> ops: matmul, layernorm, gelu, attention_xformers detected; size ~45GB FP16. quant-sim suggests dynamic per-channel int8 feasible; KV-cache pattern OK. Note: xformers attention may fallback to slower path.

Ajay K.: Infra notes: for warmup we need >=48GB GPU (FP16); quant runs can use 40GB. Recommend reserving 3x A100-80G for smoke + 2x for a small canary pool. Need VPC subnet for customer. @Ryan S. can you confirm availability?

Ryan S.: I can carve out 3 A100-80G for smoke tomorrow afternoon. Canary pool scheduling Tue AM. Will add dashboards: latency, p95/p50, token-cost, error-rate, and quality metrics (perplexity, instr-follow). Suggest run eval suite (1k) as smoke quality pass.

Lina P.: Add regression tests vs redwood-default-13b baseline. Metrics: ROUGE / accuracy / hallucination-rate on labeled subset. Also seed consistency checks for determinism.

Maria R.: Customer insisted on deterministic outputs for scorecards — we should start with greedy/deterministic sampling (no temperature) and fixed seed for canary.

Tess (ML Eng): I'll start conversion now. Commands I'm using:
```
# convert
python convert.py --input s3://acmefin/models/tempest-13b-v2/pytorch.tar.gz --out /tmp/tempest-onnx --ops-check
# quantize
python quantize.py --model /tmp/tempest-onnx --mode dynamic_per_channel --calib s3://acmefin/evals/calib.jsonl
```

QuantBot: conversion_status: partial_fallback -> xformers.attention flagged; suggestion: replace xformers attention callsites with runtime-compatible attention kernel OR patch import shim. See note: ENGRT-4821 recommended.

Ajay K.: Opening runtime ticket ENGRT-4821 with conversion logs and failing op traces. Assigning to eng-runtime.

Ryan S.: Proposed timeline: smoke + PTQ eval by EOD tomorrow, canary Tues. If runtime patch needed it may slip — will monitor. Maria, is that SLA ok?

Maria R.: That's fine. Marking as P2 (enterprise customer, not urgent-critical). I'll update the intake form and notify AcmeFin of tentative dates.

Tess (ML Eng): Marking checklist items as I go :white_check_mark: weights checksum, starting conversion. Will post conversion artifact link when ready.

QuantBot: next_steps -> run int8 calibration on 1k examples, perf run (latency & mem), and small regression eval.

Ajay K.: I'll provision VPC network and add the customer to the access list. Noting storage path and IAM scope.

Lina P.: Reminder: include eval prompts that stress factuality/hallucination (finance domain) — pinging @data-quality for annotated subset.

Maria R.: Thanks all. I'll collate notes and update the intake ticket.

(reacts: Ajay K. :thumbsup:, Tess :rocket:, Ryan S. :eyes:)
